classifications.rationale: The President presently establishes an executive-branch policy of active Federal-land management; it guides later agency action but itself changes no legal rights or status.
classifications.evidence: It is the policy of the United States to protect people, communities, and watersheds

classifications.rationale: The Secretaries must implement management policies and later develop departmental goals and implementation plans; these are planning, coordination, and prioritization duties without a dictated legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: the Secretaries shall each develop goals and implementation plans for wildfire prevention activities and programs in their respective departments

classifications.rationale: The Interior Secretary must review budget justifications and consider possible 2019 operational objectives, expressly retaining feasibility and appropriateness discretion; any implementation occurs later.
classifications.evidence: shall review the Secretary's 2019 budget justifications and give all due consideration to establishing the following objectives

classifications.rationale: The Agriculture Secretary and both Secretaries must review, consider objectives, and develop performance metrics; these are discretionary program-management and measurement tasks rather than specified legal outcomes.
classifications.evidence: The Secretaries shall also refine and develop performance metrics

classifications.rationale: The Secretaries must conduct reviews, coordination, prioritization, strategy development, procedural streamlining, and discretionary program implementation; later projects, agreements, and contracts remain subject to agency administration and applicable law rather than a presently imposed legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: the Secretaries shall jointly develop, by December 31, 2020, a strategy
